content:
**Built shipLane (#901, slice A of #888): collect, push --no-verify with a diverged pre-check, find-or-create the lane PR, arm by tier; BRAIN_MEMORY_TOKEN denylisted**

**What**: Added brain/scripts/memory/lane/ship.mjs (shipLane: runs the collector, fetches the lane ref into a tracking ref, refuses a diverged remote, pushes exactly one refspec ref:ref with --no-verify and never --force, finds today's open PR by head via mrList or creates it via mrCreate with title memory: <host> <date> (<n> records) and body Memory lane: <host> <date> / Records: <n> / file list, arms mrAutoMerge with the tier's requiredReviews; commit null AND ahead 0 means nothing to ship; mrList failure fatal, mrCreate url null fatal, every mrAutoMerge refusal non-fatal; a missing origin/main marks the record count unknown instead of zero), unit tests on fakes, an integration test with a real bare remote and a racing writer, the pre-push non-invocation pin, and MEMORY_TOKEN_ENV in credential-env's default denylist. The maintainer added the two ship files to the no-verify-bypass exemption (4e3625ed): the one sanctioned bypass, ADR-0034 L5.

**Why**: Wave 3 slice 3.1b of #864; split from #888 at the library/CLI seam (396 counted lines against 400); PR 1 closes #901, PR 2 closes #888 with the CLI op.

**Where**: brain/scripts/memory/lane/ship.mjs, ship.test.mjs, ship.integration.test.mjs; brain/scripts/lib/credential-env.mjs; brain/scripts/hooks/pre-push.test.mjs; brain/project/check-refs-rules.mjs; openspec/changes/issue-888-lane-ship/**.

**Learned**: a fresh cold review found two surviving mutants (a swallowed mrCreate failure; mrList without state open, which would match a closed lane PR forever) and a zero-record title when the base cannot be fetched; all pinned or fixed. The no-verify-bypass rule scans the whole tree, so the exemption had to land before any commit could. The fetch refspec uses + into the tracking ref on purpose: without it a non-fast-forward remote would fail the fetch and hide the divergence.
